notes.title: 1.1.4 Patch notes

1.1.4 Patchnotes
New features:

Add a save data copy feature


※ How to use the save data copy feature:
- In the slot selection screen, highlight the slot to copy and open the "manage data" menu
- Select the "Copy data" button
- The save data will be copied to the next empty slot. The copy will fail if there is no empty slot

Bug fixes:

Fix the crow enemy behaving incorrectly in Twin Spires

notes.title: 1.1.3 Patch notes
notes.content:
Patchnotes version 1.1.3
Bug fixes :

Fix slot selection screen loading indefinitely when encountering corrupted save data.

In case of save data corruption:
- open the save data folder located in %LOCALAPPDATA%\EnderLilies\Saved\SaveGames\
- rename the backup data you wish to restore:
GameSlot_backup_X_Y.sav → GameSlot_X.sav where X is the slot number, and Y is the backup number.

notes.title: 1.1.0 Patch notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38795227/49f894ad63d311612b335d616d8ddf031ad76e94.png
Patchnote 1.1.0

New features:

◆Maligned Memories: challenge your skills by fighting against all bosses one after another

Unlocked after purifying all bosses
Accessed from any restpoint in the "Memories" menu, after selecting "Maligned Memories"
The difficulty is determined by the current game's chapter
The time it took to clear the mode is saved
Obtain enhancing materials by clearing the mode. The materials obtained depend on the difficulty.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38795227/0904cff37139c51a8f8ba241eea6e51f251dac5c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38795227/e34b438a97373ab9e9fdb0430696b6cf0ab8ac77.png


◆Purified Memories: Challenge a purified boss

Accessed from  any restpoint in the "Memories" menu, after selecting "Purified Memories"
The difficulty is determined by the current game's chapter
Obtain enhancing materials by clearing the battle. The materials obtained depend on the difficulty.

◆Blighted Memories: Watch previously seen movies

Accessed from any restpoint in the "Memories" menu, after selecting "Blighted Memories"

◆New Game+: start a new adventure with current status in a harsher world

Start a new game while keeping Lily's status, actions, skills, relics and tips
All enemies will be stronger than chapter 9: enemies, bosses AI and actions are strengthened
Enhancing materials can be obtained by defeating enemies and bosses
　※Some event related items are not transferred

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38795227/de23f0c614862291ddc7022158c5c7bd83f777bd.png

Unlocked after obtaining the achievement "Dawn Prayer"
Accessed from any restpoint by selecting the "Blightborn Modes" menu

The prologue movie is played when being inactive for some time on the title screen
※This prologue movie is the trailer that was published on the youtube channel

After obtaining the achievement "Journey's End", the relic can be found at the restpoint "Blighted Heart"

notes.title: ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights v1.0 is Now Live!
notes.content:
ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights v1.0 is now available! Five more areas have been added to those available in Early Access, bringing the total up to eight. More bosses stand ready to be defeated and join Lily’s side. Her spirit companions can all be fully upgraded, new secrets lurk in the shadows waiting to be found, and the story can now be completed.

Players who have purchased ENDER LILIES in Steam Early Access will receive the v1.0 update at no cost.

Furthermore, save data from Early Access will carry over into the full game. However, since updates have been made to the opening and tutorial we recommend starting over from the beginning.

Our beautiful soundtrack from musical group Mili, who has contributed tracks to acclaimed anime franchises including Ghost in the Shell and Goblin Slayer as well as rhythm games such as Cytus and Deemo, is also available today. You can get it here on Steam, check it out on your favorite streaming service, and find it on a variety of other music storefronts.

Once again, we’d like to give a massive shout out to everyone who has supported us so far. Thank you for giving ENDER LILIES a chance in Early Access, and to everyone who has made time to share feedback with us. You have helped us make ENDER LILIES a better game and we are so excited to hear everyone’s thoughts on the full experience.

We know some of you have eagerly been asking about physical editions and additional content. Now that the game is out, we can think about adding more in future updates. Please keep an eye on our Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram pages for news, as we’ll shout from the rooftops about further developments on social media.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38795227/a802ac0cf88c6443240541942aab71a6ae35654a.png
Illus.Ayumi Yamada（Concept Artist/Cutscene Artist）

▼ New content

 new areas, bosses, enemies
new player skills
 new relics
 new parry action relic
 new "Last Rites" system (super attack)
 new tutorials
 new UI elements and various improvements
 new BGM


▼ Adjustments

Brush up Lily's animations
Adjust general game balance
Adjust enemies placement and AI
 Adjust player skills
Brush up translation in some languages
Brush up background visuals of some maps


▼ Bug fixes

 various bug fixes

notes.title: 0.7.0 Patch notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38795227/fa3b26568ff089a7c749ee4fc148ec50e03088d3.png

Thank you for playing ENDER LILIES! We are working hard towards the official release.

For players waiting for new content, we apologize for the wait, but we would like add all the new areas as part of the official release

As a first step, based on feedback we received from all of you since the beginning of the early access, we made some changes to the game systems in hopes of making the gameplay experience more enjoyable. Those changes are described in detail below.

Thank you again to everyone who has played ENDER LILIES, and especially to those of you who have taken the time to share your opinions with us!


New

Add a new "Hold" mode for summon set switch that can be activated in the game settings
Allow binding of mouse buttons in keyboard settings
Allow binding of UI inputs in keyboard settings
Add a "Hide UI" option in pause menu
Add options to hide player UI, enemies floating gauges in game settings

Adjustments
■Gameplay

Change most "Interaction" input to not require directional press 
(pick up an item, activate switch, restpoint)
Adjust camera speed when using the auto climb action
Update some UI elements
Allow wrap in most menus
Add footer in most menus
Zoom out minimap for better visibility
Update effects used for items obtained
Change conversations in events to proceed by player input instead of automatically
Update effects and animations when a skill can be used

■Player

Update underwater action :
Allow underwater dodge after obtaining 「Witch's Bubble」
Allow diving underwater while swimming horizontally by pressing ↓
Allow falling through platforms while moving
Update player knockback :
landing recovery animation can be cancelled by dodge or attack action
Update double jump effect
Update and brush up some player's animations
Update effect of heal action to follow player's location

■Spirits

「Headless Defender」
- Decrease recast time
- Decrease invincibility time after use
- Increase range
- Adjust knockback properties, make enemies fly away if their stamina reaches 0
「Umbral Knight」
- Adjust knockback properties, make enemies fly away if their stamina reaches 0
「Cliffside Hamlet Youth」
- Adjust knockback properties, make enemies fly away if their stamina reaches 0
「Gerrod, the Elder Warrior」
- Adjust effect display to match attack range

■Relics

「Ruined Witch's Book」
- Decrease the effect of underwater movement speed bonus


■Enemy

Reduce contact damages
Adjust some enemies hitbox
Adjust some magic projectiles' speed and trajectory
Add attack motions to some enemies
Adjust some enemies AI


■Map

Adjust graphic elements in some maps
Adjust location of some elevator switches



Bug fixes

Fix some maps where player could fall out of bounds
Fix jump action that could get cancelled too fast
Fix some enemies display problem
Fix 「Guardian Siegrid」's transformation action that could be skipped
Fix BGM not always switching correctly after changing map
Fix player's step effect not always triggering after changing map
Fix keyboard key state that was reset when disabling player input (ex. game map change)
Fix heal action that could be used when falling
Fix opening menu on the same frame as starting event causing UI focus to be lost
Fix 「Gerrod, the Elder Warrior」's attack that could leave its FX trail active
Fix knockback on flying enemies that was reset at each attack
Fix visual artifact on characters that was happening with some integrated GPU
Fix some items location
Fix keyboard key 「1」 that couldn't be used

Currently under examination

New defense action for attacks that are currently hard to avoid completely

Thank you.
